items.title: 21.6 Mukhtalif sitaron ke emission aur absorption spectra (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of emission and absorption spectra from stars (PDF 174-175).

blocks.text: Sitare musalsal spectrum ki roshni kharij karte hain kyunke un ki bohat garam, ghani satahein taqreeban mukammal blackbodies jaisa bartao karti hain. Jab yeh roshni sitare ki thandi bairooni fiza se guzarti hai to gas ki tahon ke atoms energy levels ke darmiyan electrons ki tabdeeliyon ke mutabiq khaas wavelengths jazb karte hain. Is se musalsal spectrum mein un jagahon par andheri lakeerein banti hain jahan khaas rang jazb hue: absorption spectrum. Agarche jazb tawanai unhi wavelengths par dobara kharij hoti hai, dobara kharij photons har simt bikhar jate hain, is liye zameen par dekhne walon tak kam pohanchte hain, aur hamein alag ghaib wavelengths wala khaas absorption spectrum milta hai. Lakeeron ka naqsha batata hai ke sitara kin anasir se bana hai.

Door ke sitaron aur kehkashaon ke emission aur absorption spectra mein lakeerein apni maloom laboratory qeematon se lambi wavelength dikhati hain (Fig 21.5). Ise redshift kehte hain, aur yeh is liye hota hai ke phailti kainat mein safar karte hue roshni khinch jati hai.

blocks.alt: Banafshi (chhoti wavelength) se surkh (lambi wavelength) tak do dhanak pattiyan, har aik par chaar andheri absorption lakeerein. Oopar ki patti (Sooraj ki roshni) mein lakeerein apni aam jagah par; neeche ki patti (door ki kehkashan) mein lakeeron ka wahi naqsha daen, surkh ki taraf, khiska hua, surkh teeron se. Neeche: z = dlambda/lambda = df/f = v/c, jab v, c se bohat kam ho.
blocks.caption: Spectral lakeeron ka redshift (Fig 21.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Lakeeron ka naqsha anasir pehchanta hai, aur poora naqsha lambi wavelengths ki taraf khiska hua hai. Khisakne ki miqdar batati hai ke kehkashan kitni tezi se door ja rahi hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Har sitare ki apni roshni ki pehchan hai. Us ke emission aur absorption spectra parh kar scientists maloom kar sakte hain ke sitara kin anasir se bana hai.

blocks.prompt: Sitaron ke spectra hamwar dhanak ke bajaye andheri lakeerein kyun dikhate hain?
blocks.explanation: Sitare ki bairooni fiza ki thandi gas khaas wavelengths (us ke atoms mein electron tabdeeliyon ke mutabiq) jazb karti hai; un wavelengths par dobara kharij roshni har simt jati hai, is liye ham tak kam pohanchti aur woh wavelengths andheri nazar aati hain.

items: Sitare: musalsal spectrum par un ki thandi fiza ki absorption lakeerein.
Lakeerein anasir pehchanti; door ki kehkashaon mein lambi wavelengths ki taraf khiski (redshift).
